presentations.body:
Why we're doing this now: MEDEXEC is in internal pilot — commissioning the SRA before scale, because compliance gets built in at the foundation or not at all.

Where we are, honestly: backend DB credential exposure identified and rotated; production on Vercel has no HIPAA BAA — stated plainly, with AWS migration as the fix; admin hardening in progress (temp super-admin password, MFA enforcement, one unknown admin under investigation); WISP drafted; marketing copy being tempered where it overclaims; BPC pilot contract and BAA signed.

What I need from RSM: scope (how they treat the Vercel-to-AWS migration), timeline and deliverable, week-one needs with an owner each, and a findings letter usable in customer diligence.

Full brief: workspace/meeting-prep/rsm-hipaa-talking-points-2026-09-29.md
